summary: Scoped network and KV-cache metadata extract for EU customer data rectification
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (EU subsidiary) submitted a data rectification request identifying a small set of prompts/responses that include outdated PII. Legal has approved a targeted, timeboxed extract to verify and implement corrections. The extract requested is minimal: network headers (source IP hash, geo-region), timestamped KV-cache metadata keys referenced by the session(s), and inference request/response IDs for correlation. No raw outputs or full payloads are requested unless strictly necessary for validation, and only after additional approvals.

Impact:
Customer expects confirmation within 5 business days. Delay increases regulatory risk (EU DPA follow-up) and customer churn risk for an enterprise-tier account. Requested extract must preserve privacy minimization controls.

Environment:
Production (prod) traffic in eu-west region. Affects a small set of sessions between 2026-02-24T00:00Z and 2026-02-24T06:00Z (customer-provided timestamps). Model: redwood/gpt-realtime-v2.

Requested window and scope:
- Time window: 2026-02-24T00:00Z - 2026-02-24T06:00Z (6-hour window)
- Filters: customer_org_id = 00234-EU-SUB and request_ids provided in attachment (10 request IDs).
- Fields requested: timestamp, request_id, response_id, kv_cache_key_identifiers (hashed), request_source_ip_hash, request_geo_region, routing_model_variant, and audit-log pointer (S3 path) for the minimal raw payload if later approved.

Justification and safeguards:
Legal and Privacy have signed off on a timeboxed extract. Access must be performed by two-person control, with KMS-wrapped keys for any decrypted artifacts, and a minimal redaction pass before any human review. Include retention/auto-delete policy (delete extract after 7 days).

Steps to retrieve (suggested):
1) Create a scoped query in the prod telemetry read-only pipeline limited to the customer_org_id and time window.
2) Join inference_events table to kv_cache_index by request_id to retrieve kv cache key identifiers (do not expand cache contents).
3) Export network header fields (ip_hash, geo) and routing metadata.
4) Store output to an encrypted S3 path under s3://redwood-privileged-extracts/INT-100987/ with kms key alias redwood-extracts-prod.
5) Notify Legal and Privacy when ready; run automated redaction script (confluence link above) before human review.

Logs / evidence included:
- Customer support thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/CUS-SUPPORT/p1623456789000123
- Customer-provided request ID list attachment: request_ids_100987.csv (attached to ticket)
- Relevant dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serving/inference-throughput?orgId=1&from=164
